name: plate-22-post-coupon
version_tag: finding #113: satellite-post tolerance ladder. Ron's photo showed the receiver has real slop on its round pivot post -> the gear cocks/drifts and the mesh alternately jams and skips. FDM makes the exact fit unguessable (hole prints under, post prints over), so this coupon carries 4 stub posts at radii 2.50/2.55/2.60/2.65 (bore stays r2.70), each with board 02h's exact seat shoulder + 3mm bearing. Drop the EXISTING printed receiver on each, pick the snug-but-free one, lock that radius into part_02h_board_v16 POST_R. Labels = post radius in hundredths. Carries xy_contour_compensation -0.06 to MATCH the board plate so the winning fit transfers. | QUIET: low speed + low acceleration (300-3000) for near-silent running.
